title: Confidential result journals require bounded authority and immutable outcome evidence
summary: Use exact append capabilities plus real ownership provenance, preserve ordinary permissions, and separate offline acceptance from model qualification.
reusable_steps: Use exact append capabilities plus real ownership provenance, preserve ordinary permissions, and separate offline acceptance from model qualification
expected_outcome: Confidential DOT result persistence must bind the canonical scope, exact resource and operation to a live one-shot capability and independently verify action, WorkItem, claim, attempt and held ownership under the cooperative lock. A role alone is insufficient. Keep immutable outcome rows and digest-bound report markers; a report marker never creates another effect or outcome. Retain existing ordinary-reader/writer paths without privileged fallback on validation failure. Before append, account for the optional LF separator and actual UTF-8 row bytes within the retained read limit, and compare the captured file fingerprint. Append failure after a possible effect retains UNKNOWN ownership and refuses automatic replay. Fence learning consumption against the current canonical candidate under the existing queue lock. Scripted offline suites qualify software contracts only: they do not establish model accuracy, provider cancellation, atomic production budgets or permission for shadow/enforce. Final local evidence:55 files1326 tests,73 gates,builds passed; source docs final authoring was blocked, so mission evidence records the final acceptance.
